add.event: 贝尔斯登披露旗下两只次贷对冲基金几乎损失全部价值
add.evidence: During the week of July 16, 2007, Bear Stearns disclosed that the two subprime hedge funds had lost nearly all of their value

add.event: 两只基金的投资者对贝尔斯登及其高管提起诉讼
add.evidence: On August 1, 2007, investors in the two funds took action against Bear Stearns

add.event: 纽约联储同意向贝尔斯登提供$25 billion贷款以提供流动性
add.evidence: On March 14, 2008, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York (FRBNY) agreed to provide a $25 billion loan to Bear Stearns

add.event: 摩根大通停止使用贝尔斯登名称
add.evidence: In January 2010, JPMorgan ceased using the Bear Stearns name.
